headline: Canadian Dollar Falls to 19-Month Low Against Broadly Stronger Greenback
summary: The Canadian dollar declined to its lowest level in 19 months as strong US economic data supported broader gains in the US dollar.
why: The Canadian dollar exchange rate responds to interest rate differentials with the US Federal Reserve and global trade balances.

impacts.name: Canadian Dollar
impacts.why: Robust US economic indicators lifted the US dollar, causing the Canadian dollar to touch a 19-month low.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger-than-expected US macroeconomic indicators boosted the greenback across global currency markets.
